title: Preflight a package dependency change
summary: Inspect a dependency change, verify explicit target, public-surface, lockfile, and consumer-check evidence, then deterministically decide whether the change may land, remains blocked, or must be reverted.

stages.title: Inspect dependency change
stages.purpose: Establish whether the dependency specification changed and classify both sides before accepting evidence about the target.

stages.title: Verify installed target
stages.purpose: Check explicit presence and resolved-version evidence against the requested target without guessing unsupported source modes.

stages.title: Verify required public surface
stages.purpose: Ensure each caller-required package path remains present in the explicit observed surface.

stages.title: Verify lockfile alignment
stages.purpose: Ensure the root specification and locked version both reflect the requested target.

stages.title: Assess consumer check
stages.purpose: Treat a named consumer check as verified, failed, or unavailable without inventing execution evidence.

stages.title: Evaluate final disposition
stages.purpose: Combine the real-change flag and every required verification into stable blockers and a land, blocked, or revert disposition.

completion.description: Completion requires a successful disposition result derived from the change classification and all four required evidence channels; land is valid only when blockers is empty.

errors.description: The Procedure request is outside the bounded canonical contract.
A bound Capability provider or Procedure implementation failed safely.
